summary: Max Verstappen won the British Grand Prix from pole position, 3.8s ahead of Lando Norris, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P15 to P6.
Pierre Gasly had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised STR (5 second time penalty).
There were 24 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 99 points over Sergio Perez.
